From: Sarah Ng <sarah.ng@zenithhealth.com>

Cc: Zenith Health Security <security@zenithhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG questionnaire — artifacts and screenshots request

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for walking us through the SIG last week. Our security team has a few follow-ups before we can move to the final review: a copy of the operational runbook for incident response, a network diagram showing VPC/subnet segmentation for the production cluster, a recent screenshot of an IAM admin role listing (can be redacted where necessary), and your data retention policy.

Can you share the items via Drive (view-only links are fine) and indicate whether we can get time-limited access for a short audit window next week? Also confirm whether you have an updated SOC 2 report we can reference.

Goal: we aim to complete the SIG validation by Aug 16 if possible.

Appreciate the help — Sarah
Sarah Ng
Security Manager, Zenith Health
security@zenithhealth.com

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for the clear list. We'll get these over to you. Quick notes:
- Runbook (incident response + escalation) — Monica owns the runbook and will upload a view-only package to Drive.
- Network diagram — we'll provide the current diagram (redacted internal IPs) and include a version history.
- IAM admin screenshot — we can provide a redacted screenshot and, if you need, grant a 48-hour view-only session from our audit account.
- Data retention policy and SOC 2 — I'll attach the policy and check with Legal on the SOC 2 distribution; we have the latest Type II report (Q2 2027) but some customers need an NDA/LOA to receive the full report.

Targeting initial delivery by EOD tomorrow (Aug 10). If you need the DocuSign link for an LOA now, tell me and I can route it.

Best,
Marcus

Redwood Inference

Monica — thanks, that looks thorough. A couple of follow-ups before we close:

1) For the IAM screenshot, can you include the role binding for the admin role (which users/groups are bound) rather than just the name list? Redacted emails are fine, we just need the membership mapping.
2) For the runbook: please call out the RTO/RPO assumptions in the incident summary page if possible.
3) CloudTrail/log exports — we'll need 48 hours of access to the logs for a sampling exercise; please propose a 48-hour window.

Also, we are prepared to sign an LOA for SOC 2 access. Marcus, can you confirm next steps for DocuSign?

Thanks — Sarah
